text_en: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 希则克雅王一听这话，就撕破了自己的衣服，穿上苦衣，走进了上主的殿；

text_en: And he sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, and Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
text_cn: 然后打发厄里雅金家宰、舍布纳书记和几位老司祭，穿着苦衣，去见阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚先知，

text_en: They said to him, “Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace; children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to bring them forth.
text_cn: 对他说：“希则克雅这样说：今天是受困难、受责罚，受凌辱的日子！因为婴儿到了要出生的时候，却没有产生的力量。

text_en: It may be that the Lord your God heard the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to mock the living God, and will rebuke the words that the Lord your God has heard; therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left. ”
text_cn: 但愿上主你的天主听见了那大将军的话──即他的主子亚述王派他来辱骂永生的天主所说的话──愿上主你的天主听了那些话而加以惩罚。请你为剩下的人民祈祷吧！”

text_en: When the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah,
text_cn: 希则克雅王的臣仆来到了依撒意亚前，

text_en: Isaiah said to them, “Say to your master, ‘Thus says the Lord : Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have reviled me.
text_cn: 依撒意亚对他们说：“你们要这样对你们的主上说：上主这样说：你听到亚述王的仆人辱骂我的话，不要害怕！

text_en: I myself will put a spirit in him, so that he shall hear a rumor, and return to his own land; I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land. ’”
text_cn: 看，我必叫他感到一种怕情，使他一听到某种消息，就返回本国；我要使他在本国内丧身刀下。”

text_en: The Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah; for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.
text_cn: 大将军回去时，正遇见亚述王去攻打里贝纳，原来他已听说君王离开了拉基士。

text_en: Now the king heard concerning King Tirhakah of Ethiopia, “He has set out to fight against you. ” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
text_cn: 那时散乃黑黎布听人说：雇士王提尔哈卡出来攻打他，就再派使者去见希则克雅，并吩咐说：

text_en: “Thus shall you speak to King Hezekiah of Judah: Do not let your God on whom you rely deceive you by promising that Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
text_cn: “你们要这样对犹大王希则克雅说：不要让你所依赖的天主哄骗你说：耶路撒冷决不会落在亚述王手中！

text_en: See, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?
text_cn: 看，你听说过亚述的列王对各国所行的，将各国完全消灭了，你还能有救吗？

text_en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, the nations that my predecessors destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
text_cn: 我祖先消灭的所有民族如：哥仓、哈郎、勒责夫，以及在特拉撒尔的厄登子民，他们的神何尝救了他们？

text_en: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, the king of Hena, or the king of Ivvah? ”
text_cn: 哈玛特王、阿帕得王、色法瓦因城的王、赫纳王和依瓦王，他们现今都在哪里？”

text_en: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it; then Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord and spread it before the Lord .
text_cn: 希则克雅从使者手中接过信来，读了以后，就走进上主的殿；将那信在上主面前展开，

text_en: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord , saying:
text_cn: 然后希则克雅恳求上主说：

text_en: “O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, who are enthroned above the cherubim, you are God, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heaven and earth.
text_cn: “万军的上主，坐在革鲁宾上面的以色列的天主，唯独你是地上万国的天主，你创造了天地。

text_en: Incline your ear, O Lord , and hear; open your eyes, O Lord , and see; hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to mock the living God.
text_cn: 上主，请你侧耳倾听！上主，求你睁眼垂视！细听那打发使者辱骂永生天主的散乃黑黎布的一切话！

text_en: Truly, O Lord , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their lands,
text_cn: 上主，的确，亚述的列王曾毁灭了所有的民族和他们的土地，

text_en: and have hurled their gods into the fire, though they were no gods, but the work of human hands—wood and stone—and so they were destroyed.
text_cn: 将他们的神像投入火中，因为它们不是神，只是人手造成的木石的作品，所以能被消灭。

text_en: So now, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone are the Lord . ”
text_cn: 但是现今，上主，我们的天主，求你拯救我们脱离他的手，好使世上万国都知道：惟独你是上主天主。”

text_en: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying: “Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Because you have prayed to me concerning King Sennacherib of Assyria,
text_cn: 那时，阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚打发人去见希则克雅说：“上主以色列的天主这样说：你既然为了亚述王散乃黑黎布而向我恳求，我已经俯听了你。

text_en: this is the word that the Lord has spoken concerning him: She despises you, she scorns you— virgin daughter Zion; she tosses her head—behind your back, daughter Jerusalem.
text_cn: 这就是上主论他所说的话：熙雍贞女轻视你，嘲笑你；耶路撒冷少女在你背后摇头！

text_en: “Whom have you mocked and reviled? Against whom have you raised your voice and haughtily lifted your eyes? Against the Holy One of Israel!
text_cn: 你辱骂诅咒的是谁？你提高声音，仰起眼睛攻击的是谁？是攻击以色列的圣者。

text_en: By your servants you have mocked the Lord, and you have said, ‘With my many chariots I have gone up the heights of the mountains, to the far recesses of Lebanon; I felled its tallest cedars, its choicest cypresses; I came to its remotest height, its densest forest.
text_cn: 你藉你的仆人辱骂了吾主，你说：我用我的大批车辆，登上了丛山的极峰，到黎巴嫩的山顶，砍伐了其中最高的香柏，最好的青松；我冲入了人迹罕到之处，走进了果木的林园。

text_en: I dug wells and drank waters, I dried up with the sole of my foot all the streams of Egypt. ’
text_cn: 我掘了井，喝了外邦的水，用我的脚掌踏干了埃及所有的河川。

text_en: “Have you not heard that I determined it long ago? I planned from days of old what now I bring to pass, that you should make fortified cities crash into heaps of ruins,
text_cn: 难道你没有听见：很久以前我所计划的，昔日我所决定的，现在我就实现，叫你毁坏坚城，化为废墟，

text_en: while their inhabitants, shorn of strength, are dismayed and confounded; they have become like plants of the field and like tender grass, like grass on the housetops, blighted before it is grown.
text_cn: 使城中的居民软弱无力，惊惶失措，有如田野的青草，有如青绿的嫩苗，有如屋顶上被东风吹焦的小草。

text_en: “I know your rising up and your sitting down, your going out and coming in, and your raging against me.
text_cn: 你或起或坐，或出或入，以及对我的癫狂，我都知道。

text_en: Because you have raged against me and your arrogance has come to my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth; I will turn you back on the way by which you came.
text_cn: 因为你对我的暴怒，和你的狂嚣，已达到我的耳鼓，所以我要把环子穿在你的鼻子上，把辔头套在你的嘴上，由你来的路上将你牵回去。

text_en: “And this shall be the sign for you: This year eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that; then in the third year sow, reap, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
text_cn: 这是给你的记号：今年你要吃自然所生的，明年你仍要吃自然所生的，第三年你们要播种收获，栽种葡萄，吃园中的果实。

text_en: The surviving remnant of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward;
text_cn: 犹大家所剩余的人，仍要向下生根，往上结实。

text_en: for from Jerusalem a remnant shall go out, and from Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.
text_cn: 因为剩余的人将由耶路撒冷而出，逃脱的人将从熙雍山而来：万军上主的热诚必要成就这事。

text_en: “Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come into this city, shoot an arrow there, come before it with a shield, or cast up a siege ramp against it.
text_cn: 为此，上主论亚述王这样说：他决不会进入这城，决不会向这城放射一箭，决不会持着盾牌，走近城下，造起土堆攻城。

text_en: By the way that he came, by the same he shall return; he shall not come into this city, says the Lord .
text_cn: 他必要由来路回去，决不能进入这城：上主的断语。

text_en: For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David. ”
text_cn: 为了我自己，为了我的仆人达味，我必要保护拯救这城。”

text_en: Then the angel of the Lord set out and struck down one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians; when morning dawned, they were all dead bodies.
text_cn: 于是上主的使者出来，在亚述的营里杀了十八万五千人。清晨人们起来，见遍地是死尸。

text_en: Then King Sennacherib of Assyria left, went home, and lived at Nineveh.
text_cn: 亚述王散乃黑黎布于是拔营，班师回国，住在尼尼微。

text_en: As he was worshiping in the house of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped into the land of Ararat. His son Esar-haddon succeeded him.
text_cn: 当他在自己的神尼色洛客庙里叩拜的时候，他的儿子阿德辣默肋客和沙勒责尔用剑刺杀了他，然后逃到阿辣辣特地方去了。他的儿子厄撒哈冬继他为王。
